title: DataBall must have micro-benchmarks for its hot read and open paths
lead: In db-10 a host-load slowdown was briefly mistaken for a code regression, because the only timing signal was whole-suite duration. Benchmarks give a deterministic signal for paths hosts call often, and relay reviewers can compare them between the branch point and the branch.
**Owner gate:** BenchmarkDotNet (MIT) would be a new test-only dependency in a new non-packed project. It needs owner approval first.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** running benchmarks in CI; performance budgets that fail the build.

sections.heading: Files
Implement
sections.body:
1. Bring the dependency to the owner, and stop until approved.
2. Add the project and benchmarks; record one baseline run's numbers and the machine load in a note.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build DataBall.sln -c Release` (the benchmarks project builds).
- The full Release test suite is unchanged.
- `slicer check`
